'''Anem''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyemari]]. The [[Nyemari Royal Palace]] was located there, as was the [[Nyemari Imperial Military Installation]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|team]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members [[Mission to Nyemari|infiltrated]] the Duchess' Royal Palace to steal her access codes. The Rebels escaped the Palace in an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], leading the Royal guards on a chase through Anem before going back to their [[Starship/Legends|ship]] at the [[South Anem Spaceport]]. The Rebels then had an encounter with a [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] messenger; the hologram he gave the Rebels before being [[Death/Legends|killed]] led them to the [[Sixela system/Legends|Sixela system]].

==Description==
Anem was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyemari]]. The planet's rulers resided there, in the [[Nyemari Royal Palace]]. The [[Nyemari Imperial Military Installation]] was also in the city. The city's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was the most modern, architecturally sophisticated port in the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]]. The city itself was a maze of [[Skyscraper/Legends|skyscrapers]], a veritable forest of [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] and [[Duracrete/Legends|duracrete]]. One of the towers was thirty stories tall.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

The [[South Anem Spaceport]], a large warehouse, was located a few [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away in an area where the city's edge bled into the [[Desert/Legends|desert]]. Other portions of Anem were dusty and disused with trash strewn about.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==History==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the planet's Duchess resided in the Royal Palace. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], a [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|team]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives [[Mission to Nyemari|infiltrated the Palace]] to steal the Duchess' access codes to the Nyemaril [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] facility. Their mission succeeded, but they were forced to flee the Royal Palace in a commandeered [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]]. A group of Royal guards chased them through the city on [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]]; the Rebels [[Blaster/Legends|blasted]] through buildings when they could not go around them.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

Eventually, the guards fell behind and the Rebels escaped to where they had hid their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] at the South Anem Spaceport. Once there, they were met by the [[Nyemarian]] mechanic [[Li Preni]], who told them they were being followed. Thinking it was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], the Rebels pursued the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] through the alleys of Anem until they cornered him in a dusty, disused plaza. The Glymphid brought out a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] to give to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] from [[Rezi Soresh]]; the hologram threatened the [[Death/Legends|death]] of 100 hostages if Skywalker did not come meet Soresh in the [[Sixela system/Legends|Sixela system]]. The Glymphid then died from a time-delayed [[Poison/Legends|poison]] and the Rebels left to meet Soresh.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Behind the scenes==
Anem was established in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2010]] book ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''.
